peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is agitation in fermentation?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Agitation plays an important mixing and shearing role in fermentation processes. It not only improves mass and oxygen transfer between the different phases, but also maintains homogeneous chemical and physical conditions in the medium by continuous mixing.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is the shape of Xanthomonas oryzae?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: On nutrient agar (NA), after 3-7 days of growth, colonies of X. oryzae pv. oryzae are circular, entire, smooth, convex, opaque, and pale to straw yellow,1-2 mm in size. Optimum growth temperature is between 25 and 30°C.
